title: 检查点复用必须绑定执行路线与输入身份
summary: 昂贵工作检查点只有在 provider/base URL/model/源语言/目标语言等执行路线一致，且单条输入指纹仍匹配时才能安全复用；路线变化或输入变化应失效而不是猜测兼容。
invariants: Execution route identity includes provider, endpoint/base URL, model and relevant language roles.
Per-record reuse validates an input fingerprint, not only a display filename or old output presence.
Legacy checkpoints may be read only under their historically implicit route assumptions.
Completed paid work is persisted after each batch so later failure does not discard already-paid results.
Route/input mismatch invalidates reuse without deleting the historical checkpoint.
